description: Donated by the Swedish state maritime and transport history museum to the Aviation Museum Society in 2022 and placed on permanent display beside the terminal at Turku Airport in June 2023. Repainted in the Aero Oy 1963 scheme and displays the marks OH-LEA which are not its own registration.
aliases: SE210; SE-210; Caravelle; OH-LEA; Sinilintu; Bluebird
